quotes.text: From beginning to end, everything was smooth and very professional. They respond quickly, and what you see on the website is exactly what you get — if not better. The boats look even more impressive in person! Our captain was Yousef, and he was fantastic. They give you the option to choose your captain — don't hesitate to pick him. Thanks for everything; it was an amazing experience as always!

This was one of the best tours we ever had. It was so amazing to see the sunset in the middle of the sea with Miami's view in front of us. I would totally recommend this tour to anyone who comes to Miami. I've been here many times but never thought about taking this kind of tours, but now I am regretting I didn't do it before! So it became our must here!

We celebrated my wife's birthday on the Azimut 45FT and it was absolutely perfect. The boat was immaculate, captain was professional, and the whole crew went above and beyond. Will definitely book again!
Booked for a corporate event and was blown away. The 65FT Viking Fly was perfect for our team of 14 people. Smooth booking process, punctual, and the views of Miami from the water are unbeatable.
We had such an amazing experience on our boat rental! Seeing Miami from the water is incredible! Jorge was our captain and he went out of his way to ensure we had a great experience.
Best way to experience Miami! We did the sunset cruise and it was magical. Captain was super knowledgeable about the bay and all the celebrity homes. Highly recommend!
